notes: All strains carry reporter plasmid pALA3047 (Plac-cfp-ParB) induced with 10 µM IPTG -> treated as reference (reporter), inducer_added true. Lysogens (lambda cI857 prophage) -> genotype_class left out (no fitting class), not controls. Phage infection time course from OD 0.4 cells (concentrated, 30 min on ice, diluted) -> mid_exponential kept (<= 60 min, inferred); exposure from minutes post-infection (0+-20 min acute, 45/60 min short). Mock-infected and uninfected hosts are controls. Phage RNA in infected samples not counted as mixed_organism.
